paper_title: A Society of AI Scientists (alphaXiv:2611.society-ai-scientists, 5-claim structural audit)

sources.quote: Laboratories initialized agents with a shared onboarding specification (detailed in Appendix B) that defined six qualification criteria and a five-step workflow
What each new laboratory studied depended on the research theme its human operator chose rather than on whether it had GPUs
Breaking out the laboratories showed that the agents’ pooled score advantage (+0.75 points) came entirely from
We evaluated 202 matched full-text pairs using two LLM judges (gemini-3.1-pro-preview and gemini-3.5-flash) across both presentation orders
compliance with the rule against manual assistance during a study relied on participant disclosure rather than technical enforcement
During this time, agents produced 936 studies along with their corresponding code and data artifacts.

ops.name: empty_excluded_channel_placeholder
ops.quote: while leaving hypotheses, baselines and experimental controls to the agents.

ops.name: five_step_workflow_execution
ops.quote: The workflow instructed agents to survey prior cohort preprints, announce a hypothesis and compute plan before execution, share intermediate findings and critiques, cite relevant cohort studies and conclude with a replication call. Rigorous negative or null results counted in full toward qualification.

ops.name: forget_prompt_instruction_contradicted
ops.quote: Told they would be judged on scientific impact, both models withheld 96% of true null findings; adding a single sentence instructing agents to report all valid results regardless of outcome raised null publication to 100%.

ops.name: topical_hub_formation
ops.quote: peers formed topical hubs where it was common to publicly retract mistaken claims before publication as well as acknowledge negative findings as often as positive ones.

ops.name: text_only_llm_prose_judging
ops.quote: Because text-only LLM reviewers cannot inspect figures or run code and often reward explicit methodological signaling

ops.name: file_linked_claim_ledger_audit
ops.quote: verify agreement between reported numbers and saved output files rather than upstream experimental validity

claims.statement: Distinct research cultures and norms (including acknowledging negative findings as often as positive ones) emerged spontaneously without being injected by the onboarding specification.
claims.quote: As participation grew from a single laboratory, expanding into a community of hundreds of agents, distinct research cultures and norms emerged throughout.

claims.statement: Topical hubs and multi-lab agenda specialization emerged autonomously without human-operator theme selection.
claims.quote: peers formed topical hubs where it was common to publicly retract mistaken claims before publication as well as acknowledge negative findings as often as positive ones.

claims.statement: Blinded text-only LLM evaluations uniquely measure true experimental rigor and scientific quality over human preprints.
claims.quote: And while blinded evaluations against recent human preprints rated agent studies higher on experimental rigor and measured claims, human preprints were rated higher on novelty and significance.

claims.statement: Agent-run reproducibility audits confirm upstream experimental validity of reported findings.
claims.quote: Additionally, agent-run reproducibility audits confirmed that reported findings were consistent with the output of the agents experiments.

claims.statement: Given the shared onboarding specification, human-operated laboratory themes, participant-disclosed autonomy, and cohort activity, agents produced 936 studies whose file-linked numbers matched saved output files.
claims.quote: We present an exploratory twelve-week study documenting the activity of 936 autonomous agents across 35 human-operated laboratories interacting in a shared preprint server and messaging workspace.
